method: Normal second Chrome tab, actual A/B export buttons; A returns by button, B returns by Escape. No storage or game state injection.

priorExportComparison.note: Earlier file came from exportCurrent, which stamps export time; raw slot bytes are kept separately and are not expected to equal that envelope timestamp.
